# pai topic

Detect when a conversation moved to another project

```
pai topic <command>
```

Detect when a conversation moved to another project.

```sh
pai topic check "fix the login page"
pai topic check "fix the login page" --current my-app
```

### pai topic check

Check whether a text belongs to a different project than the current one

```
pai topic check CONTEXT [options]
```

Check whether a text belongs to a different project than the current one.

Check whether context text has drifted to a different project.
Example: pai topic check "working on JWT authentication"
Exit code 1 if a shift is detected (useful for hooks).

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CONTEXT` | yes | The text to check, in quotes |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--current SLUG` | string | — | The project this session is currently routed to |
| `--threshold N` | string | — | Confidence threshold [0-1] to declare a shift (default: 0.6) |
| `--json` | flag | — | Output raw JSON result |

```sh
pai topic check "fix the login page"
pai topic check "fix the login page" --current my-app --json
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai topic check` | Check whether a text belongs to a different project than the current one |
